LanguageData.Gun_P38K_RWP.description: A compact and lightweight pistol, the P38K is designed for close-quarters combat. With moderate stopping power and a quick firing rate, it is ideal for sidearm duties and personal defense. Its simplicity and reliability make it a popular choice among settlers for day-to-day protection.
